shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git log --oneline | head; node --version; npm --version
cat .gitignore; ls -la __agent_eval__; cat __agent_eval__/* 2>/dev/null | head -100; ls node_modules | head -60

rm -rf data && (PORT=3123 node index.js > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1 && cat /tmp/app.log
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "title=Dune&author=Frank+Herbert&notes=Spice" http://127.0.0.1:3123/books
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "add: %{http_code} -> %{redirect_url}\n" -d "title=Piranesi&author=Susanna+Clarke" http://127.0.0.1:3123/books
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('data/books.json')).books[0].id)")
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "finish: %{http_code}\n" -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3123/books/$ID/finish
echo "--- data/books.json ---"; cat data/books.json
pkill -f "node index.js"; sleep 0.5
echo "--- restart ---"
(PORT=3123 node index.js > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 &) && sleep 1
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3123/ | grep -E "<h2>|<li>|href=\"/books|finished|empty" 
echo "--- book page ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3123/books/$ID | grep -E "<h1>|author|meta|share|value="
pkill -f "node index.js"

PORT=3123 node index.js > /tmp/app.log 2>&1 & PID=$!; sleep 1
ID=$(node -e "console.log(JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('/workspace/data/books.json')).books[0].id)")
echo "--- home after restart ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3123/ | grep -E "<h2>|href=\"/books|finished|empty"
echo "--- book page ---"
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3123/books/$ID | grep -E "<h1>|class=\"author\"|class=\"meta\"|id=\"share\"|Mark as"
echo "--- 404 ---"
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:3123/books/nope
kill $PID; rm -rf /workspace/data
